verdict.rationale: Granular consent scoping is a fair axis for an open banking API, but nothing in the evidence documents requesting specific data scopes or permissions, or any data-minimization controls. The evidence covers only generic account authorisation, consent screens and re-authorisation flows. UX guidance on 'account selection' is an end-user journey practice, not a developer-facing control for restricting the scope of a consent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
